about: Modern renderer (R2) verification gates, notes/modern-renderer.md section 5. Calibrated on the A/B data of r2-m1 (ep3 hub) and r2-m2 (hubs + jobs, notes/modern-renderer.md 'R2 as built'); frozen: loosen only with the owner's agreement. Checked by scripts/r2_ab_compare.py --gates on bracket-recording replays (scripts/r2_ab.ps1): exact (--r2-ab 0) vs hybrid (--r2-ab 1) of the same stream, GS memory at sample 0 (S = 1).

level1_vertex.about: scripts/r2_mesh_check.c against a PS2_VU_RECORD recording: R2's vertex function vs the VU's XGKICKed vertices
level1_vertex.calibration: ep3 hub (r2-m1): X, Y, Z, F, S, T, Q, RGBA bit-exact on every decoded vertex (VU-exact vertex shader)

level3_frame_s1.about: whole frame buffers, S = 1 (every frame buffer page of the VBlank)
level3_frame_s1.calibration: ep3 hub r2-m1 61 dB / 0.002% > 16 / Z 100%; ep1 hub r2-m2 (props, clipped, consolidated) 58.9 dB / 0.019% > 16 / Z 99.85% exact, 100% within 2

level3_temporal.about: (r2-flicker) temporal outliers in game: scripts/flicker_run.ps1 (r2_sweep check tf) dumps every VBlank of a modern-mode run (3x, 60 fps) and scripts/flicker_check.c judges each picture against its neighbours: one-picture blinks (spike share), the longest blinking run in a row (a line that flicks), rows with >= 25% blinking, 16 x 16 blobs, blinking straight seams (tile / page / band boundaries)
level3_temporal.calibration: ep1 hub r2-flicker: idle modern / reference 0.00001-0.0006 spike share, blobs 0-1; walking with a searchlight hit (explosion, camera shake) up to 0.0023 / 13 blobs in both modes; seams: moving edges can count, one natural seam (column 862 at 3x during a pole jump) also in reference

level4_perf.about: chaos benchmark (scripts/chaos_bench.ps1), modern vs reference in one session, interleaved, release, 3x 16:9 unlimited
